mapper.update: MERGE INTO MODE_VOTE mv USING ( SELECT #{participantId} AS PARTICIPANT_ID , #{voteMode} AS VOTE_MODE FROM DUAL ) src ON ( mv.PARTICIPANT_ID = src.PARTICIPANT_ID ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET mv.VOTE_MODE = src.VOTE_MODE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( VOTE_ID , PARTICIPANT_ID , VOTE_MODE ) VALUES ( SEQ_MODE_VOTE.NEXTVAL , src.PARTICIPANT_ID , src.VOTE_MODE )
mapper.select: SELECT mv.PARTICIPANT_ID , mv.VOTE_MODE FROM MODE_VOTE mv JOIN PARTICIPANT p ON p.PARTICIPANT_ID = mv.PARTICIPANT_ID JOIN ROOM r ON r.ROOM_ID = p.ROOM_ID WHERE r.ROOM_UUID = #{roomUuid} ORDER BY mv.PARTICIPANT_ID
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM MODE_VOTE WHERE PARTICIPANT_ID IN ( SELECT p.PARTICIPANT_ID FROM PARTICIPANT p JOIN ROOM r ON r.ROOM_ID = p.ROOM_ID WHERE r.ROOM_UUID = #{roomUuid} )
